value.name: appraiser inspects house thoroughly
value.description: Beverly Ostrowski moves through the house repeatedly, inspecting it room by room and taking notes with a laser.
evidence: Beverly Ostrowski moved through the house room by room, top to bottom, then bottom to top, then a second pass through the principal rooms with the laser.

value.name: appraiser questions household details
value.description: Beverly asks about the boiler, roof work, and rear addition while the family answers different kinds of questions.
evidence: She asked about the age of the boiler, the date of the most recent roof work, the condition of the rear addition.
Rosa answered the practical questions. Daniel answered the financial questions. Lucia answered the sentimental questions

value.name: appraiser treats house as family history
value.description: Beverly's questioning reveals her understanding that the house is both a financial asset and a family fact.
evidence: Beverly was the kind of appraiser who understood that a row house in Philadelphia was both a financial asset and a fact about a family, and that the family's account of it could not change the number but could change the appraiser's confidence in the number.

value.name: appraiser gives appraisal timeline
value.description: At two o'clock, Beverly says she will provide a preliminary number by Friday and a written report the following Wednesday.
evidence: At two o'clock Beverly closed her clipboard and said she would have a preliminary number by Friday afternoon and a written report by the following Wednesday

value.name: appraiser departs after handshake
value.description: Beverly shakes hands with each family member and leaves the house.
evidence: she shook hands with each of them and let herself out

value.name: family regroups in dining room
value.description: After Beverly leaves, the four of them sit together again in the dining room.
evidence: In the dining room the four of them sat again.

value.name: Asha presents memorandum page
value.description: Asha brings only a single page listing options for the upcoming meeting and places it on the table without comment.
evidence: Asha had brought no folder this time.
She had brought only a single sheet of paper, which was the page from the memorandum that listed the options for the meeting two weeks from today, and she laid it on the table without comment.

value.name: Asha postpones discussion
value.description: Asha tells the others they do not have to discuss the issue immediately because they have until next Wednesday.
evidence: "We don't have to talk about this now," she said. "We have until next Wednesday.

value.name: Asha reframes appraisal limits
value.description: Asha explains that the report will value only the building and not speak about the family, setting up the next conversation.
evidence: But the report will not say anything about you. It will say only what the building is worth.
